items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section XIII, List of Answers on Terminology 63:1
items.html: Metzpatz is the interchange of HaVaYaH by At-Bash, and it indicates the aspect of the screen and Malchut in the HaVaYaH, which in ZA is the aspect of the name Elokim, and in Arich Anpin is Metzpatz, because there is no revealed aspect of the female or of judgment in it. (Page 384, Item 184; and see Or Pnimi there).
